extracted.name: Watermelon Popsicles
extracted.description: These watermelon popsicles are a blend of fresh watermelon and honey frozen in popsicle molds for a cool, refreshing, and fruity summer treat.
instruction_lines: Blend watermelon, water, honey, lemon juice, and sugar together in a blender until smooth.
Pour mixture into popsicle molds and freeze until solid, about 2 hours.
Run hot water over popsicle molds for a few seconds to unmold.
